validity_findings.finding: Critical FIX-1 verified: _dirichlet_multinomial_log_marginal uses K=K_categories=12 (N_STATES) not K=len(counts). Recomputed K2 log BF 643.088782 (alpha0.5), 338.671097 (alpha1.0), 167.898395 (alpha2.0) exactly match result.json/raw_results.json; deterministic positive control 854.131357/916.179931 also exact. Parent bug +3700-4000 nat upward bias is fully explained; corrected null medians -78.36/-130.91/-116.10 confirm Occam penalty. Frozen spec measurement_validity K=12 satisfied.

Frozen spec measurement_validity #11 and prereg 4.6 define K2 as state + last 2 actions (a_{t-1},a_t) and K3 as state + last 3 actions (a_{t-2},a_{t-1},a_t) (action-history conditioning). Implementation uses K2=build_state_history_records(2) -> state history (url_before + 2 previous urls) and K3=build_action_history_records(3) -> action history (url_before + 3 previous actions + current). Thus primary K2 tests action effect beyond state-history, not beyond action-history as frozen, and K3-K2 compares different history kinds (state lags vs action lags) making Phase2 K3-K2 =235.03 nats apples-to-oranges. Recomputed spec-correct K2 (history 1 prev action) gives BF 3298.3 median -415.6 PASS C1/C3 stronger than producer; spec-correct K3 (history 2 prev actions) gives BF 1955.9 median +7.07 FAIL C1. Spec-correct K3-K2 = -1342 nats (negative), opposite sign to producer's +235. Main C1/C3 verdict robust to correction (both state-history and spec-correct K2 pass), but Phase2 beyond-Markov inference is invalid under this mismatch and must be treated as exploratory only (spec itself says Phase2 only if SURVIVES on C1, does not gate).

FIX-2 verified: N_SHUFFLE=1999 satisfies frozen spec >=1000 and resolves p<0.001 threshold (min achievable p=0.0005). Recomputed null max -21.14/-92.94/-92.77 all << observed 643/339/168; count_ge=0 => p=(0+1)/2000=0.0005 correct for all alphas. 99.9th percentile -25.40/-96.94/-95.87 computed via numpy.percentile and separation 194-669 nats matches result.json. Parent N=500 cap p=0.001996 issue resolved.

All evidence synthetic SPA (50 sessions x100 steps, seed42, 12 states, CANDIDATES 48/48 verified, 50% hash +50% uniform). Validity note correctly states no support for C-WEB-DYNAMICS (real Web dynamics). Claim must not be generalized to production SPAs, titles, DOM, network payloads, or high-cardinality state spaces. Environment can express tested effect (true I(Y;A|Z)=1.52 bits established in parent chain) and did express it (det_ratio 0.254 K2 stochastic, deterministic control >>0).

Stratum size distribution heavily fragmented: 343 strata 5-9 records (2147 records), 37 strata 10-19 (433), 0 with >=20. C7 >=2 buckets PASS (2 non-empty) recomputed exactly; <30% strata with >=5 not measured but C7 satisfied. Bayesian exact marginal handles small strata without Laplace bias, but representation loss disclosed. Both buckets show positive observed BF (187.6 and 68.0 nats at alpha 0.5) indicating robustness to small samples when K=12 penalty correct.

Deterministic SPA positive control passes: K2 854.13/K3 916.18 nats at alpha0.5 (also 467/500 at 1.0, 235/251 at 2.0) >>0 confirms implementation can detect strong action effects. Stochastic/det ratio 0.25-0.09 consistent with 50% stochasticity mixture. Control is strong and appropriate.

Phase2 K3-K2 point estimate +235.03 nats at best alpha0.5 but bootstrap 95% CI [-415.20,34.39] includes zero (n_bootstrap=200, mean -169.46) indicating high variance due to limited within-session action diversity and history-space fragmentation (K2 n_strata 1438 vs K3 841, n_full_params 853/1567 vs 2418/2804). Producer correctly treats Phase2 as exploratory per frozen spec and does not gate SURVIVES verdict (code checks only K3-K2>0 as C2). Frozen spec C2 also requires permutation p<0.01 for difference, not computed; and history-kind mismatch (V2) further invalidates difference. Phase2 cannot support beyond-Markov claim at N=5000.

No leakage detected: within-session shuffled-action null preserves session structure, state sequence, url_before/url_after pairing and shuffles only action labels via per-session Random shuffle (run_experiment.py:334-359). Target P(S_next|S_current,A) vs P(S_next|S_current) operationalized correctly with exact Dirichlet-Multinomial (lgamma) not variational/BIC. Sampling N=5000 (50*100) seed42 SHA 8cff7c33... verified deterministic vs stochastic designs.

claim_ceiling: SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST is supported ONLY for synthetic stochastic 12-state hash-routed SPA (CANDIDATES 48/48, 50% deterministic +50% uniform, N=5000, seed42) using exact Dirichlet-Multinomial Bayesian model comparison with K=n_states=12 and N_SHUFFLE=1999 within-session shuffled-action null, conditioned on state-history K2 = (url_before + 2 previous urls). Across alpha_prior {0.5,1.0,2.0} null median -78 to -131 nats <0 (C1 PASS) and observed log BF 168-643 nats exceeds max null by 194-669 nats, 99.9th percentile, p=0.0005 <0.001 (C3 PASS). Establishes Bayesian paradigm as first of 5 tested estimator families (plug-in KL, entropy-rate CMI, KSG CMI, LR chi2, Bayesian) to pass simultaneous C1+C3 on this artifact class, bypassing Laplace smoothing bias. Ceiling EXCLUDES: (i) C-WEB-DYNAMICS / real Web dynamics, (ii) production Web data/high-cardinality states, (iii) beyond-Markov K3-K2 (exploratory, history-kind mismatch state-vs-action and bootstrap CI includes zero; spec-correct action-history K3 median +7 fails C1 and K3-K2 -1342), (iv) product promotion (synthetic only), (v) generalization to other alpha priors beyond 0.5-2.0 or to variational/BIC approximations.
